title: Uniform duality for convex-body covering entropy
exact_target: Are there constants $a,b\geq1$, independent of dimension and of the convex bodies $K,L$ symmetric about zero, such that $\log N(K,L)\leq b\log N(L^\circ,a^{-1}K^\circ)$ always holds, where $N(K,L)$ is the least number of translates of $L$ covering $K$ and $K^\circ=\{y:\sup_{x\in K}x\cdot y\leq1\}$ is the polar, defined similarly for $L$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
